$:set -eu
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
gh run download 42584933907 --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --name combined-identifiers-members --dir "$tmpdir"
python3 - "$tmpdir/combined-identifiers-members.json" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys,json,base64,subprocess,hashlib
from urllib.parse import quote
source=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
data=source.read_bytes()
record=json.loads(data)
assert len(record['identifiers'])==4785
assert sum(bool(arr) for arr in record['identifiers'].values())==1044
assert sum(len(arr) for arr in record['identifiers'].values())==7287
assert len(record['member_expressions_without_identifier_base'])==1475
assert all(len(arr)==len(set(arr)) for arr in record['identifiers'].values())
assert len(record['member_expressions_without_identifier_base'])==len(set(record['member_expressions_without_identifier_base']))
assert record['coverage']['files_in_inventory']==774
assert record['coverage']['javascript_files']==321
assert record['coverage']['javascript_files_parsed']==319
assert len(record['parse_errors'])==2
assert len(record['coverage']['repositories'])==9
repo='BestNameYet/Terminals'
dest='workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/identifiers-members.json'
def gh(method,endpoint,payload=None):
    args=['gh','api','--method',method,'repos/'+repo+'/'+endpoint]
    if payload is not None:args+=['--input','-']
    cmd=subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(payload) if payload is not None else None,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=100)
    if cmd.returncode:raise RuntimeError(method+' '+endpoint+' '+cmd.stderr[-1200:])
    return json.loads(cmd.stdout)
try:
    gh('GET','contents/'+quote(dest,safe='/')+'?ref=main')
except RuntimeError as exc:
    if '404' not in str(exc):raise
else:raise RuntimeError('Destination already exists: '+dest)
blob=gh('POST','git/blobs',{'content':base64.b64encode(data).decode(),'encoding':'base64'})
head=gh('GET','git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha']
oldtree=gh('GET','git/commits/'+head)['tree']['sha']
newtree=gh('POST','git/trees',{'base_tree':oldtree,
    'tree':[{'path':dest,'mode':'100644','type':'blob','sha':blob['sha']}]})['sha']
commit=gh('POST','git/commits',{'message':'Persist nine-repository deduplicated identifier and member index',
                                   'tree':newtree,'parents':[head]})['sha']
gh('PATCH','git/refs/heads/main',{'sha':commit,'force':False})
actual=gh('GET','git/blobs/'+blob['sha'])
assert base64.b64decode(actual['content'])==data
tree=gh('GET','git/trees/'+gh('GET','git/commits/'+commit)['tree']['sha']+'?recursive=1')['tree']
entries=[x for x in tree if x['path']==dest]
assert len(entries)==1 and entries[0]['sha']==blob['sha']
print(json.dumps({'status':'VERIFIED','path':dest,'commit':commit,
  'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
  'identifiers':len(record['identifiers']),
  'member_expressions':sum(len(v) for v in record['identifiers'].values()),
  'member_expressions_without_identifier_base':len(record['member_expressions_without_identifier_base']),
  'failed_javascript_files':len(record['parse_errors'])}))
PY
